resources.string: Connect when the selected iPhone reconnects
After the car wakes, open DiPlay and start wireless CarPlay when the selected iPhone connects over Bluetooth. Some head units restrict background launches.
If this takes too long, return to the home screen and save a diagnostic report.
Check that the selected iPhone is nearby, unlocked, and connected to the car over Bluetooth.
Keep Wi-Fi on for both the car and iPhone while the wireless link starts.
The devices are connected. Waiting for the CarPlay session and first picture.
Unlock the iPhone and allow the USB or trust prompt if it appears.
DiPlay will retry. If retries stop, use Retry connection; repeated failures can be saved in a diagnostic report.
Proportional position on the full cluster panel. The actual small-window edge varies by car.
